items.t: Why an SEC Director Calls a WSJ Ad on Tokenized Stocks ‘Misleading’
items.sum: Jamie Selway, Director of the SEC’s Division of Trading and Markets, and Brett Redfearn, President of Securitize, respond to the backlash against tokenized stocks, including a Wall Street Journal ad Selway calls misleading.

items.t: 5 “Forever Income” Dividend Stocks Yielding 5% and More for Boomers
items.sum: Two of these retirement income payers slashed their dividends in 2020, and one more cut years earlier. Before you trust any of them with your paycheck, see which safety test each stock passes and which risk could still bite.
